testCases.testName: Capsule Update - UEFI Update - Firmware Update - Capsule Update, Manual

testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. For this test you will likely be working with Prod_Signed capsules. Ensure BitLocker and Secure Boot have been disabled prior to starting manual Capsule Update and Rollback.
2. Open registry editor
a. Navigate to HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentContolSet\Control\FirmwareResources\
b. Add REG_DWORD “Policy” with the Value of 1 to the key of each capsule under test. You can find the correct firmware by the ID or arrowing down through the menu and identifying the correct file name.
3. Create folders on Desktop with current and rollback capsules
a. Each folder should contain an .inf file, a .cat file, and a .bin file
4. Open: “Current” folder
a. Right click the .inf file
b. Select install
c. Select Restart Now when prompt appears
d. Blue loading bar will be present when installing the new UEFI capsule
5. Enter UEFI Menu to verify FW version

testScenarios.notes:
1. Configure unit as listed above and have type/touch kbd  connected 
2. Open manage bit locker and turn on bit locker  (must have thumbdrive to copy recovery key to) 
3. After Bitlocker is enabled and drive is encrypted open GPedit.MSC 
4. Navigate to: Computer configuration>Administrative Templates>Windows Components>Bitlocker drive Encryption>Operating System Drives 
5. Enable use of Bitlocker authentication requiring preboot keyboard input on slates. 
6. Double click on Require additional authentication at startup 
7. Uncheck Allow Bitlocker without compatible TPM 
8. Check Enabled box and under Configure TPM startup Pin  Select Require startup PIN with TPM 
9. Now launch an elevated cmd prompt 
10. Type: manage-bde -protectors -add c: -TPMAndPIN 
11. It will prompt to enter pin    Enter a 4 digit numerical pin that is easy to remember (*Note  what you enter will not show on screen 
12. It will ask you to enter the same pin again, do so 
13. Now Type manage-bde -status   (to check whether the TPMAndPin protector has been added. 
14. Close all windows and reboot machine
